English version in below
◎時間：2025.6.30~2025.7.30
◎地點：里賈納大學
◎費用：CAD 5095 約NTD 117,000 （費用中不包含機票、簽證費用、保險、旅遊及其他個人花費）

◎報名時間：2025.5.15截止

◎報名流程
1.填寫google 表單向國際處報名，同時繳交以下文件：
Google form：https://reurl.cc/2jAzQ9
在學證明
家長同意書 (下載範本Form：海外短期交流家長同意書https://oia.ndhu.edu.tw/var/file/27/1027/img/920907695.doc )
2.自行到姊妹校提供之連結報名: https://reurl.cc/rE8m7x
3.等待姐妹校通知

◎注意事項：
1.有任何申請問題可以聯繫活動承辦人: esl@uregina.ca
2.具體申請細節及其他資訊請詳閱簡章。
2.具體申請細節及其他資訊請詳閱簡章。
3.活動結束後請依照格式繳交心得報告至國際處網站：https://oia.ndhu.edu.tw/p/412-1027-21515.php?Lang=zh-tw
4.國際處僅公告或協助本校學生報名參加簽約校的短期活動或課程，其短期課程是否可抵免本校學分，參加學生需遵照教務處相關規定辦理。若活動日期為本校學期上課期間，學生須依照本校規定自行辦理請假手續。

◎更多資訊
https://www.uregina.ca/academics/english-second-language-esl/index.html

English version
◎Period：2025.6.30~2025.7.30
◎Location：University of Regina
◎Fee：CAD 5095 around NTD 117,000 Fee does not include airfare, visa fees, insurance, traveling, and other personal expenses.

◎Registration Deadline：Until 2025.5.15

◎Registration Process
1. Sign up via google form and upload below documents to OIA.
Google form：https://reurl.cc/2jAzQ9
Student Status Certificate
Parental Consent Letter(Form：Parental Consent Letter https://oia.ndhu.edu.tw/var/file/27/1027/img/920907695.doc )
2. Complete application at: https://reurl.cc/rE8m7x
3. Await the announcement from sister school.

◎Please note:
1.For any application inquiries, please contact the program organizer at: esl@uregina.ca
2.For detailed application instructions and other information, please refer to the brochure.
3.After the event, please submit a reflection report according to the specified format：https://oia.ndhu.edu.tw/p/412-1027-21515.php?Lang=en
4.OIA only announces or assists our school’s students in registering for short-term activities or courses offered by contracted schools. Whether credits from these short-term courses can be transferred to our school is subject to the regulations of the Academic Affairs Office, and participating students must comply accordingly. If the activity falls within our school’s academic semester, students must follow our school’s regulations to apply for leave of absence.

◎More information
https://www.uregina.ca/academics/english-second-language-esl/index.html
